Provide a clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

-->

<!--
Explain the motivation behind this feature.
- What use case does it enable?

-->

## Proposed Solution

<!--
Describe how you envision this feature working.
Include examples or mockups if helpful.
-->

<!--
Have you considered other approaches?

-->

<!--
Any technical considerations or potential challenges?

-->

<!--
Are there existing issues, discussions, or ADRs related to this?
Link them here.
